title: Why are our cities digging the same roads again and again?

Many agencies work separately, leading to roads being dug up multiple times. Integrated planning and digital mapping are needed to manage infrastructure better. Smarter governance is essential as India's urban population continues to grow.

title: Earth’s largest ocean is shrinking and could create supercontinent Amasia
content: The Pacific Ocean, which is the largest ocean on Earth, is gradually shrinking due to the convergence of tectonic plates. Subduction zones around its edges are consuming the ocean floor at a rate faster than new material is formed. Scientists estimate that in 200 to 300 million years, the Pacific could entirely close up, pulling continents together to create a new supercontinent.

title: Scientists survey Mount Ararat glacier above 5,000m for first ice core
content: A German-Turkish research team has completed the first scientific survey of the glacier on Mount Ararat, Turkey's highest peak, to study its potential as a record of climate and human history. Scientists mapped the shrinking ice cap to identify the best site for drilling the mountain's first ice core, hoping it will reveal thousands of years of environmental and archaeological information before melting erases it.

title: Nanaji Deshmukh Awas Yojana: How workers can avail Rs 1.6 lakh housing aid

title: Karnataka cabinet expansion: 12 new faces out of 20 MLAs being inducted - full list
content:
Shivakumar leads Karnataka cabinet revamp

Twenty new ministers are set to be inducted into the Karnataka government as the state cabinet undergoes a major expansion, with the swearing-in ceremony likely to take place at 4 pm on Monday, after the governor approved their inclusion. G S Patil has been chosen as the new speaker of the Karnataka Legislative Assembly, while A S Ponnanna will serve as the deputy speaker, as cited by PTI. Here is the full list of new ministers:
